# Launch Screen Assets

Generated from `assets/images/app_icon.png` by `dart run tool/generate_launch_assets.dart` (run from `genesis_app/`).

The centered icon is 96×96 logical pixels with a 12px corner radius. The same command generates Android launch images and synchronizes native startup backgrounds from `GenesisColors.darkBackground`; rerun it after changing the source icon or token.

Launch appearance is always dark, independent of the system theme. Android 12 keeps a separate resource for the platform splash canvas and icon mask.
